Package io.github.janglada.orkit

Interface Solver<S extends Solution>

All Known Subinterfaces:
CpSatSolver<S>
All Known Implementing Classes:
RoutingSolver
public interface Solver<S extends Solution>
Configurable solver for an OptimizationProblem, obtained via OptimizationProblem.solver().

This interface carries only the knobs every backend honors. CP-SAT backed domains return a CpSatSolver, which adds worker count, random seed, intermediate-solution callbacks, warm starts, and cancellation. The routing domain returns RoutingSolver, which adds first-solution and metaheuristic selection instead (OR-Tools routing search exposes no worker count or seed).

The setter methods return this so calls can be chained, terminating in solve().
